title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: site establishment and traffic
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Site fencing, hoardings and gantries
swms.task: Erect the site fencing, hoardings and the gantry over the footpath, next to the street, and set up the site sheds.

facts.fallControl: Gantry decks have edge protection with mesh infill before anyone works on them.
facts.systemInstructions: The gantry is to the engineer's design GN-01 (revision B) for 10 kPa on its overhead platform, plus the site sheds on it, erected by licensed intermediate scaffolders.

swms.title: Traffic management at the site gate
swms.task: Traffic controllers manage trucks, concrete trucks and mobile plant deliveries at the site gate and on the street next to the site, and separate plant and pedestrians on site.

steps: Separate plant and people on site

rules.phrase: a fully sheeted hoarding at least 1,800 mm high
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 315F, s 315G
rules.quote: a hoarding at least 1,800mm high that is fully sheeted

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 315K
rules.quote: have natural or other lighting of at least 50 lux

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 315K
